Container.Name: isputnik-faces
Container.Overview:
The face engine for isputnik.home: finds the faces in the family's photos and describes each one, so isputnik.home can group them into people. Everything stays on your server. Alpha.
This container has no sign-in, no web address and no data of its own: isputnik.home sends it photos and keeps every face, name and person itself. Set up: put both containers on one user-defined Docker network (docker network create isputnik); in isputnik.home open Control panel, Settings, Apps, choose Faces, enter http://isputnik-faces:4400 as the address, press Generate secret and paste it here as Gateway Secret. Face recognition is switched on per photo library under Control panel, Library, Libraries.

Config.Name: Gateway Secret
Config.Description: The secret made in isputnik.home under Control panel, Settings, Apps, Faces (Generate secret, then Copy), or a long random string of at least 32 characters (openssl rand -hex 32) also set on the isputnik container as FACES_GATEWAY_SECRET. Every request the home server sends carries it. Required: the server refuses to start without it, or with a short one.

Config.Name: CPU threads
Config.Description: How many CPU threads a scan may use. Left empty, all cores but one, so the box stays responsive while a scan runs; set 1 to throttle hardest, or a higher number to finish sooner. A CPU limit on the container works too.

Config.Name: Load models on start
Config.Description: 1 loads the models (about 200 MB of memory) when the container starts rather than at the first photo, so the first scan of the night does not wait on it.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the server runs as. It runs unprivileged (not root) and writes nothing, so any user will do; 99 (nobody) matches the other isputnik containers.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the server runs as.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal or silent. The isputnik container shows this log under Control panel, Overview, Logs.
